diagnosis.root_cause: PROCESS-CONDITIONING GAP: the SEED is process-keyed (e.g. water in water-cycle -> MOVE; water in respiration -> CREATE) but the READING extractor is ENTITY-GLOBAL (water -> whichever fate dominates in general prose). The same entity has DIFFERENT fates in different processes, which entity-global reading structurally cannot disambiguate. So reading EXTENDS coverage (combined 0.387 > seed-only 0.210, +0.177 new) and its acquisition RISES with exposure, but it does NOT RE-DERIVE the seed's process-conditioned precision (dominant seed/reading overlap 3/13; lesion gap 0.161) -> the crutch cannot fully fade. The recall-ANY metric (0.50, overlap 0.85) LOOKS like fade but is promiscuity-inflated (3 fate classes, reading asserts ~all fates per popular entity); the promiscuity-robust DOMINANT metric is the honest one.
diagnosis.scramble_confound: 3-class fate recall has a high modal base rate (~0.16 = fraction of held-out gold containing the corpus-modal fate CREATE), so neither recall-any (retained 0.61) nor dominant (retained 0.71) scramble collapses below the 0.50 gate; the true entity-specific signal above the scramble floor is only ~0.0645.
diagnosis.answer_to_needs_better_frontend_or_diffe: DIFFERENT (richer) GROWTH MECHANISM: reading must be PROCESS-CONDITIONED (extract (entity, process, fate), i.e. know which process a sentence describes) to re-derive the seed's process-keyed knowledge. The frontend/extractor precision is fine (v2 hand-check 0.90); the limitation is the entity-global GRAIN of the acquired facts vs the process-keyed grain of the seed/target.
diagnosis.what_DID_work: (1) reading is a real no-LLM growth channel: acquisition rises with exposure (dominant 0.048->0.226) and reading+seed combined (0.387) beats seed-only (0.210); (2) hd_fact_store trust-conflict-resolution PROTECTED the seed 102/102 (a wrong low-trust READING fact never overwrote a right high-trust SEED fact under a FUNCTIONAL relation); (3) store wire-witness clean; (4) no-leak guard caught + excluded 13 incidental DEV-sentence overlaps.
